title: Tape copying: London Town by Wings | 1977
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

On 14 December 1977 Paul McCartney compiled two tape reels of the stereo mixes created so far for the London Town album.

Acetate discs were then cut of the mixes, which were taken away by McCartney for review over the Christmas holiday.

This was Wings’ final studio session of 1977. More mixes were created in January, along with overdubs for ‘I’m Carrying’, ‘Girlfriend’, ‘Morse Moose And The Grey Goose’.
